title: Phoenix Ghosts Boos and Booze Haunted Pub Crawl
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the haunted side of Phoenix on this spine-tingling haunted pub crawl, where ghostly legends meet local libations. 

This guided tour takes you to four unique watering holes, which may include a mix of craft producers and historic bars, each with its own eerie history. Between drinks, you'll explore some of Phoenix’s most infamous haunted locations, such as the Rosson House, Orpheum Theater, St. Mary’s Basilica, and Que Sazon (Teeter House), uncovering chilling tales of restless spirits and unexplained phenomena. 

At each stop, you’ll hear expert storytelling about the city’s paranormal past while soaking in the historic atmosphere. You’ll spend 15 minutes to an hour at each location, depending on the stop, with the exact lineup varying by day and season. 

While drinks are not included, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to sip on your favorite beverages as you delve into the haunted history of Phoenix. Join us—if you dare—for a night of spirits, both liquid and lingering!
